title: 第1302章 一百年帝路第一重天的决战第1301章 魔界大军的强大
slug: 付费才能修仙我的宗门全免费
content_zh:
什么是养蛊王？
一千位炼气境魔族，在一起自相残杀，最终只能活下来一人，拥有踏入筑基的资格！
活下来的那一个，就是真正的精英，真正的杀戮机器！
然后一千位这样的筑基魔族，再次自相残杀，决出一位金丹魔族！
一千位金丹魔族，又再决出一位元婴魔族！
所有魔族生灵经过这样的层层筛选，每一位都经历了残酷的磨砺，战力之强横，远非其他几界同境界强者所能相比！
在这种残酷规则下，不知道多少魔族自相残杀，才能出一位地仙境魔族！
这就是蛊王！
因此有一句话，同境之中，魔族最强！
只有妖族才能在肉身方面稍微与魔族碰一下！
其他几界，很难在低境界战场上与魔界抗衡。
它们最精锐的大军，可能才只能与魔界普通大军相提并论！
而魔界精锐大军，几乎无敌！
..........
第一重天大战还在继续。
第三十五年，鬼界与神族的一支大军在一片山谷上撞了个正着。
神族二十万亿天使大军结成了审判之阵，圣光普照之下，鬼界那些阴魂厉鬼本该被克制得死死的。
可鬼界阴兵压根就没打算跟神族正面硬刚，它们布下了一座万亿噬魂大阵，硬生生将那片山谷变成了一片鬼蜮。
阴风怒号，鬼气森森，数不清的厉鬼从地下钻出来，将神族天使一个个拖入地下。
鬼界大军只付出了十万亿阴兵的代价，就把神族二十万亿天使吃得干干净净！

神族四大主神的脸色，当时就黑了。
第四十八年，魔界跟鬼界也干了一仗。
这一次魔界只出动了五亿大军，而鬼界那边足足有十万亿！
数量上倍杀了！
远古战场上那些观战的强者们一开始还觉得魔界这次托大了，可结果却让所有人都大跌眼镜。
五万亿魔界大军直接将十万亿鬼界大军杀了个对穿！
万亿噬魂大阵在魔界大军那滔天的魔气面前，彻底崩溃了。
这一战，鬼界全军覆没，而魔界折损的，只有区区不到两万亿！
远古战场上，杀戮魔王靠在王座之上，那双猩红的魔瞳中满是玩味。
他身后那十一尊禁忌魔王更是笑得肆无忌惮。
其他几界的强者们全都沉默了。
五次。
十次。
content_en:
What is Gu King Raising?
A thousand Qi Refining realm demons killed each other together, and in the end only one person survived, who was qualified to step into the foundation building!
The one who survives is the real elite, the real killing machine!
Then a thousand of these foundation-building demons will fight each other again to determine a golden elixir demon!
One thousand Jindan Demon Clan, and another Nascent Soul Demon Clan was chosen!
All the demon creatures have gone through such layers of screening, and each one has experienced cruel tempering. Their fighting power is far beyond the comparison of powerful men of the same realm in other realms!
Under such cruel rules, countless demons would kill each other before one demon from the Earthly Immortal Realm can be born!
This is the Gu King!
Therefore, there is a saying that among people in the same realm, the demons are the strongest!
Only the demon clan can have a slight physical contact with the demon clan!
In other realms, it is difficult to compete with the demon realm on the low-level battlefield.
Their most elite army may only be comparable to the ordinary army of the demon world!
And the elite army of the demon world is almost invincible!
...........
The First Heavenly War is still going on.
In the thirty-fifth year, a large army of ghosts and gods collided in a valley.
The 20 trillion angel army of the gods formed a judgment formation. Under the shining of the holy light, the ghosts in the ghost world should have been restrained to death.
But the Yin soldiers of the ghost world had no intention of confronting the Gods head-on. They deployed a trillion soul-devouring array and turned the valley into a ghostly beast.
The dark wind howled and the ghostly aura was strong. Countless ghosts emerged from the ground and dragged the angels of the gods into the ground one by one.
The army of the ghost world only paid the price of 10 trillion Yin soldiers, and ate up the 20 trillion angels of the Gods!
The faces of the four main gods of the God Clan turned dark at that time.
In the forty-eighth year, the demon world and the ghost world also fought a war.
This time, the demon world only dispatched an army of 500 million, while the ghost world had a total of 10 trillion!
Kill twice as many!
The strong men who were watching the battle on the ancient battlefield thought at first that the Demon Realm was overpowering this time, but the result surprised everyone.
The five-trillion demon army directly killed the ten-trillion ghost army!
The trillion soul-devouring formation completely collapsed in front of the monstrous demonic energy of the demon army.
In this battle, the entire ghost world was wiped out, while the demon world only lost less than two trillion!
On the ancient battlefield, the Killing Demon King was leaning on the throne, his scarlet eyes full of amusement.
The eleven forbidden demon kings behind him were laughing unbridled.
The strong men from other realms all fell silent.
five times.
ten times.
